# Ayaz Aftab — Performance Marketing & E-commerce Growth Lead

> Performance Marketing & E-commerce Specialist with 5.5+ years of hands-on experience scaling D2C, B2B, and marketplace brands. Track record managing monthly paid ad spend exceeding ₹6L+ across Meta and Google at sustained 4.0x–4.5x ROAS, driving 9,400+ qualified acquisitions, generating ₹7.95L+ GMV across WooCommerce & Amazon, and lifting store conversions by 20%.

Based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India (`+91 9263588321`, `ayazaftab9@gmail.com`). Open to full-time Performance Marketing & E-commerce Growth Lead roles, freelance campaigns, and monthly growth retainers worldwide.

## Verified Performance Metrics

- **₹6.0L+ Monthly Ad Spend Managed**: Sustained **4.0x–4.5x ROAS** across Meta Ads and Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max).
- **₹7.95 Lakhs+ GMV**: Generated across D2C WooCommerce and Amazon Seller Central storefronts with **+40% Amazon discoverability** and **+30% organic search traffic**.
- **9,452+ Qualified Acquisitions**: Delivered via direct-response Meta Ads funnels while reducing CPA/CPL by **35%** and lifting landing page conversion rates by **20%**.
- **247,000+ Organic YouTube Views**: Built and scaled an organic video channel from scratch through search-intent hooks and YouTube Video SEO.
